title: Blackout
description: The lab's lights are out and the Bloom has taken the staff. Sneak through a pitch-black facility by flashlight, finish the jobs, grab the keycards and get out alive — then spend what you banked rebuilding your bunker. Solo, online co-op or deathmatch.
